messages:
Laila Singh: Hey everyone! I’m Laila (she/her). First day today — super excited to join the infra team. I’m based in Portland and plan to be in the SF office Tue/Wed. I have a very loud polka-dot mug and a tendency to over-ferment sourdough. Small Qs: does anyone know who grabbed the polka-dot mug from the kitchen? Also where do we pick up badges if I swing by today? :wave: :coffee:

welcome-bot: Welcome to Redwood Inference, Laila! Check the #help channel for badge pickup hours and bring a photo ID. :tada:

Avery Chen: welcome, Laila! :raised_hands: I work near the sink — lots of mugs end up on the top rack. If you’re in today I can point you to the badge station (2nd floor lobby).

Maya Chen: Hi Laila!! polka-dot mugs are my weakness. If you don’t find yours check the drying rack or the open cubbies by the window. If it’s still gone, ping Facilities. Also, we have a casual lunch group at 12:30 today if you want to join.

Sam Pizza: Yo Laila — welcome aboard. If your mug is missing it’s probably in a meeting room. Pro tip: put a tiny sticker on the bottom (I have a label maker in my drawer). Also bass players unite? :guitar:

Rory Patel: Badge pickup is quick. Go to reception, sign the clipboard, tell them you’re with Eng Infra and they’ll scan you in. If they give you a temporary badge, DM me and I’ll add you to the office Wi-Fi group.

Facilities: Hi Laila — Facilities here. We’ll check the kitchen cameras (no video saved, just live) and check lost-and-found. If you describe the mug (polka-dot, blue/white, chipped rim?) we can search the shelf. We also have spare ceramic mugs labeled "community".

Laila Singh: Thanks everyone — polka-dot is white with tiny navy dots, chipped on one rim. I’ll swing by around 11:15 and try reception. Lunch group sounds great, I’ll pop in. Also love the sticker idea — very Sam. :laughing:

Avery Chen: That’s the one I thought of — saw it on a meeting room table yesterday. If you want I can grab it and put it on your desk before 11:15.

Laila Singh: Amazing, thank you!! Desk deposit accepted. Coffee meetup soon? I bring weird sourdough tales. :bread:

Maya Chen: Meet us by the espresso machine at 12:27. Bring tales.

Sam Pizza: Don’t forget to add your snack prefs to the onboarding doc — we’ll send you a tiny welcome snack pack. :cookie:

Laila Singh: Will do. Super happy to be here — see you later today!"
